  echo: false
  message: false

---

Use the explorer below to look up any NCAA Division I wrestling team, view their all-time tournament record (2022–2025), and explore individual wrestler records.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

records <- read_csv("ncaa_wrestler_records.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

school_names <- c(
  "AF" = "Air Force", "AMER" = "American", "APP" = "App State", "ARMY" = "Army West Point",
  "ASU" = "Arizona State", "BELL" = "Bellarmine", "BING" = "Binghamton", "BLO" = "Bloomsburg",
  "BLOO" = "Bloomsburg", "BRWN" = "Brown", "BUCK" = "Bucknell", "BUFF" = "Buffalo",
  "CAMP" = "Campbell", "CBU" = "California Baptist", "CHAT" = "Chattanooga", "CIT" = "The Citadel",
  "CLAR" = "Clarion", "CMU" = "Central Michigan", "COL" = "Columbia", "COR" = "Cornell",
  "CP" = "Cal Poly", "POLY" = "Cal Poly", "CSU" = "Cleveland State", "CSUB" = "CSU Bakersfield",
  "DREX" = "Drexel", "DUKE" = "Duke", "EDIN" = "Edinboro", "F&M" = "Franklin & Marshall",
  "FM" = "Franklin & Marshall", "GMU" = "George Mason", "GW" = "Gardner-Webb", "HAR" = "Harvard",
  "HARV" = "Harvard", "HOF" = "Hofstra", "ILL" = "Illinois", "IND" = "Indiana",
  "IOWA" = "Iowa", "ISU" = "Iowa State", "KENT" = "Kent State", "LEH" = "Lehigh",
  "LH" = "Lock Haven", "LHU" = "Lock Haven", "LIU" = "LIU", "LR" = "Little Rock",
  "UALR" = "Little Rock", "MD" = "Maryland", "MICH" = "Michigan", "MINN" = "Minnesota",
  "MIZZ" = "Missouri", "MSU" = "Michigan State", "NAVY" = "Navy", "NCST" = "NC State",
  "NDSU" = "North Dakota State", "NEB" = "Nebraska", "NIU" = "Northern Illinois", "NW" = "Northwestern",
  "OHIO" = "Ohio", "OHST" = "Ohio State", "OKLA" = "Oklahoma", "OU" = "Oklahoma",
  "OKST" = "Oklahoma State", "ORST" = "Oregon State", "PENN" = "Penn", "PITT" = "Pittsburgh",
  "PRIN" = "Princeton", "PSU" = "Penn State", "PUR" = "Purdue", "RID" = "Rider",
  "RUT" = "Rutgers", "SDSU" = "South Dakota State", "SIUE" = "SIU Edwardsville", "STAN" = "Stanford",
  "UNC" = "North Carolina", "UNCO" = "Northern Colorado", "UNI" = "Northern Iowa", "UVA" = "Virginia",
  "UVU" = "Utah Valley", "VMI" = "VMI", "VT" = "Virginia Tech", "WIS" = "Wisconsin",
  "WVU" = "West Virginia", "WYO" = "Wyoming"
)

wrestlers <- records |>
  mutate(
    school_name = recode(school_code, !!!school_names, .default = school_code),
    team = paste0(school_name, " (", school_code, ")")
  ) |>
  group_by(team, school_name, wrestler) |>
  summarise(
    years = paste(sort(unique(year)), collapse = ", "),
    weights = paste(sort(unique(weight)), collapse = ", "),
    total_wins = sum(wins),
    total_losses = sum(losses),
    win_pct = round(100 * total_wins / (total_wins + total_losses), 1),
    record = paste0(total_wins, "-", total_losses),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(team, desc(total_wins))

shared_wrestlers <- SharedData$new(wrestlers)
```

## Team selector

```{r}
#| echo: false
filter_select(
  id = "team-filter",
  label = "Choose a team to filter wrestlers:",
  sharedData = shared_wrestlers,
  group = ~team,
  multiple = TRUE
)
```

## Wrestler records

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(
  shared_wrestlers,
  colnames = c("Team", "School", "Wrestler", "Years", "Weight Class(es)", "Wins", "Losses", "Win %", "All-Time Record"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(targets = 1, visible = FALSE)
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "cell-border stripe hover"
)
```

## All-time team summary

All-time tournament records (2022–2025) aggregated across all wrestlers for each team:

```{r}
#| echo: false
team_summary <- wrestlers |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    wrestlers = n(),
    total_wins = sum(total_wins),
    total_losses = sum(total_losses),
    win_pct = round(100 * total_wins / (total_wins + total_losses), 1),
    record = paste0(total_wins, "-", total_losses),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_wins))

datatable(
  team_summary,
  colnames = c("Team", "Tournament Wrestlers", "Total Wins", "Total Losses", "Win %", "Team All-Time Record"),
  options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "cell-border stripe hover"
)
```
